title: PortPilot Migration Plan
description: Emitted by port-planning. The ONLY input port-migration is allowed to act on. Every task traces back to finding IDs from analysis.json.

round.description: Which analysis round produced this plan. Incremented when port-review returns FAIL and forces a replan.

rung.description: Migration strategy ladder. 1=rebuild as-is, 2=rebuild+swap native deps, 3=shim the Linux surface, 4=Arm64EC hybrid, 5=replace UI layer, 6=native WinUI 3 rewrite of UI. The agent picks a rung and does not silently jump rungs mid-run.

rungJustification.description: Why this rung and not the one below it. Required - an unjustified rung is a rejected plan.

supersedesRound.description: Set when this plan replaces an earlier one after a FAIL verdict.

skill.description: Which migration skill executes this task, e.g. build-retarget, platform-abstraction.

addressesFindings.description: Finding IDs this task resolves. A task with no finding behind it does not belong in the plan.

dependsOn.description: Task IDs that must complete first. The plan is dependency-ordered.

status.description: Updated by port-migration as it works.

acceptanceScenarios.description: Product scenarios that migration must execute and review must bind to runtime evidence.

requiredTestSuites.description: Complete suite manifest inherited from analysis and required from build evidence.

openQuestions.description: Things analysis could not resolve from evidence. Migration must not guess at these.

outOfScope.description: Explicitly excluded work, so review does not flag it as incomplete.
